'''Tilossa's residence''' was a three storied prefabricated building that was used as [[Tilossa]]'s home and base of operations. It was stolen from a [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ship]] that was headed to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="H&S" />

===First floor===
The first floor was used as a [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] for Tilossa's personal security force.<ref name="H&S" />

===Second floor===
The second floor had meeting rooms and an apartment for the Water Boss [[Tanse]].<ref name="H&S" />

===Third floor===
Tilossa had his elaborately decorated living quarters on the third floor. There was also a kitchen and dining area on the floor.<ref name="H&S" />
